name: Sosna alepska A
description: A mature Aleppo pine (Pinus halepensis) of the dry Attic coast, about 12 m tall: a leaning, slightly crooked trunk with fissured grey-red bark and an open, irregular crown of needle tufts; the pine of the timber yards and hillsides (R-THEOPHRASTUS-HP5: merchant ships of peuke, pine; Cyprus builds with Aleppo pine).
